## Runs 6–7: SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`), electron n = +3.2×10¹² and hole n = −1.2×10¹²

Run 6: electron side, (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166), B 0 → 10 T, 10 mT steps above 1 T. Run 7: hole side, (−0.277, −0.465), B 10 → 0.3 T, 20 mT steps. Both use the run-5 calibration, T 1.17–1.29 K, 10 nA, sr1 at 50 µV (5 kΩ full scale). Raw Rxx(B) comes first, then `sdh_onset` and 1/B FFTs with a poly-5-in-B background removed, compared against F_L = (h/4e)|n| and the ABAB model lines (`fs_count_b0`, scale 1). On run 6 the onset and FFT windows stop at **7.4 T**: between 7.4 and 8.2 T, Rxx steps up 40 → 500 Ω, and a global poly-5 background fitted across that step leaks into the low-B end. Fitted over the full record, the step made `sdh_onset` report the 7.1 T tone as censored at 0.30 T. That value is an artefact of the step.

"""Runs 6-7 - sdh-spot-check at D = 0 (run-5 cal): electron n = +3.2e12 (B 0->10 T), hole n = -1.2e12 (B 10->0.3 T).
Raw first, then onset (sdh_onset) and 1/B FFTs (sdh_fft) against F_L and the ABAB model lines."""
import sys, warnings
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.home() / "measurement_env" / "hera" / "models" / "tetralayer_fs_count"))
import fs_count_b0 as FS

SPOTS = {6: dict(n=3.2, side="electron", onset_win=(0.3, 7.4), wins=[(0.9, 7.4), (1.3, 7.4), (2.0, 7.4)]),
         7: dict(n=-1.2, side="hole", onset_win=(0.3, 10.0), wins=[(0.7, 10.0), (0.7, 5.0), (2.0, 10.0)])}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 8.5))
for j, (rid, sp) in enumerate(SPOTS.items()):
    r = run(rid)
    ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    R = np.abs((r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I)
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R, I = B[o], R[o], I[o]
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(sp["n"]) * 1e16))
    abab = sorted(float(f) for f, k in FS.abab_fs(sp["n"] * 1e16)[1])
    print(f"run {rid} ({sp['side']}, n = {sp['n']:+.1f}e12, D = 0): {len(B)} pts, B {B.min():.2f}-{B.max():.2f} T, "
          f"R {R.min():.0f}-{R.max():.0f} Ohm (5 kOhm FS -> max {R.max()/50:.0f}%), I_drain {I.min()*1e9:.2f}-{I.max()*1e9:.2f} nA, "
          f"T {r.col('T_sample').min():.2f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.2f} K, interrupted={r.interrupted}")
    print(f"  F_L = {FL:.2f} T; ABAB model (scale 1) {[round(f, 2) for f in abab]} T; ABCA model = F_L (single pocket)")
    lo, hi = sp["onset_win"]; m = (B >= lo) & (B <= hi)
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        on = sdh_onset(R[m], B[m], r_full_scale=5000.0)
    print("  " + on.summary().replace("\n", "\n  "))
    ax[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=0.7)
    ax[0, j].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0, j].set_ylabel("Rxx B_1-B_2 (Ohm)")
    ax[0, j].set_title(f"run {rid}: raw Rxx(B), {sp['side']} n = {sp['n']:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
    ax[0, j].axvline(on.onset_b, color="r", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"sdh_onset {on.onset_b:.2f} T")
    ax[0, j].legend(fontsize=8)
    for lo, hi in sp["wins"]:
        f, S = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, hi), bg_degree=5, log=False, nfft=2048)
        s = S[0]
        pk = [i for i in range(2, len(f) - 1) if s[i] > s[i - 1] and s[i] > s[i + 1] and f[i] > 1.0]
        pk = sorted(pk, key=lambda i: -s[i])[:6]
        print(f"  FFT [{lo}, {hi}] T (dF {1/(1/lo-1/hi):.2f} T): " + ", ".join(f"{f[i]:.1f}({s[i]/s[pk[0]]:.2f})" for i in sorted(pk)))
        ax[1, j].plot(f, s / s.max(), lw=0.8, label=f"[{lo}, {hi}] T")
    ax[1, j].axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L {FL:.1f} T")
    for fa in abab:
        ax[1, j].axvline(fa, color="C3", ls=":", lw=1)
    ax[1, j].set_xlim(0, 1.6 * FL); ax[1, j].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[1, j].set_ylabel("|FFT| (norm.)")
    ax[1, j].set_title(f"run {rid}: FFT in 1/B, poly-5-in-B bg (red dotted: ABAB model)"); ax[1, j].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.suptitle("vti-02 sdh-spot-check runs 6-7 (D = 0, T = 1.17-1.29 K, 10 nA, sr1 50 uV)")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

**Read (runs 6–7): a preview only, no stacking call from these.**

- **Electron, n = +3.2×10¹² (run 6).** The onset is **0.91 T**, from `sdh_onset` on the 0.3–7.4 T window, carried by the 7.1 T tone. That tone sits at the ABAB light-pocket model line (7.31 T at scale 1). There are also strong tones at **22.3 and 29.5 T**, plus 14.1 T. The ratio screen flags all three as ~2/3/4× of 7.1 T, but the investigation forbids a ratio-only harmonic screen: 22.3 and 29.5 T also sit where an ABAB heavy pocket would, since the model heavy tone is 25.8 T at scale 1. Two pairings each close the Luttinger sum inside the lever-arm prior:
  - 7.1 + 22.3 = 29.4 T (scale 0.89)
  - 7.1 + 29.5 = 36.6 T (scale 1.11)

  **No tone sits at F_L = 33.1 T.** That is where an ABCA singleton would be, and m* = 0.074 is not LK-suppressed at this T. At one density, harmonic and pocket readings of 22.3/29.5 cannot be told apart. Their n-dependence decides: a harmonic tracks k·f₇.₁ exactly, a pocket follows its own Onsager curve. The **7.4 → 8.2 T step** (Rxx 40 → 500 Ω) sits at B ≈ F_light. That fits the light pocket reaching its last Landau level, but it is a hypothesis. It should move with F_light(n) across a fan.
- **Hole, n = −1.2×10¹² (run 7).** The onset is **0.71 T**, carried by the 6.6 T tone, which is dominant at 0.53·F_L. The ABAB near-CNP pair is 5.9/6.5 T, closer together than the 0.77 T resolution, so it is unresolved here. There are further tones at 4.7 and 8.5 T, and a strong **12.3 T ≈ F_L** (onset 1.6 T). An ABCA singleton at this density has m* ≈ 1.1 mₑ and should be LK-dead. So 12.3 T reads first as a sum/breakdown tone (≈ 6.6 + 5.9) or a 2× harmonic, and origin discrimination is owed before it carries any weight. The D = 0 line ends at n = −1.27×10¹² at the TG limit, so the hole side cannot leave the near-CNP exception regime inside the validators.
- **Side for the fan: electron.** Both sides show clean SdH with sub-1 T onsets. Only the electron side reaches the densities where the templates separate (|n| ≳ 2–3×10¹²): there the heavy-tone vs F_L split is 3.5–7.5 T, and the partner tone gets ≥ 5 periods from n ≈ 2.5×10¹². Hand-off numbers for `landau-fan`: B_lo = 0.91 T (computed), Δ(1/B) ≈ 0.010 T⁻¹ as sampled near the onset by the spot check, 5 kΩ full scale with max 12 % used, and a 3 s settle (10τ) per point.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`, governed by `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count`)

> **05:27** · landau-fan-vti e-side D=0: n 3.25->2.00e12 (30 pts, dn 0.043) x B 0.9->10 T uniform-1/B (103 rows, d(1/B) 0.0099), fast 2.1 s (7 tau), sr1 50 uV fixed; ends 10 T, gates parked 0 · **ETA ~09:07** (≈3h40m)

**Why this fan.** The spot checks (runs 6–7, ana) show clean SdH on both sides with sub-1 T onsets. They cannot decide the stacking at one density. At n = +3.2×10¹², tones sit at 7.1, 22.3 and 29.5 T, and nothing at F_L = 33.1 T. The 22.3 and 29.5 T tones read either as harmonics of 7.1 T or as an ABAB heavy pocket, and each pairing closes the Luttinger sum at a different lever-arm scale (0.89 or 1.11). Only the **n-dependence** separates them: a harmonic tracks k·f exactly, a pocket follows its own Onsager curve, and f₁ + f₂ = F_L(n) across density pins the scale. **Side: electron.** At D = 0 the hole side ends at −1.27×10¹² (TG limit), inside the near-CNP exception regime. The electron side reaches +3.25×10¹², where the ABAB heavy tone sits 3.5–7.5 T below F_L.

**Design (binding checks computed, one fan):**
- **B_lo = 0.90 T**: the run-6 `sdh_onset` gives 0.91 T.
- **n_max = 3.25×10¹²**: the D = 0 line meets the TG limit here (V_tg = 0.998 V).
- **n_min = 2.0×10¹²**: the model heavy-tone vs F_L split (3.55 T) is ≥ 2·δF_heavy (1.5 T). The partner tone reaches ≥ 5 periods from 2.5×10¹².
- **N_n = 30**: the ray-Nyquist floor, 2 points per 4eB/h = 0.087×10¹² at B_lo.
- **N_B = 103, uniform in 1/B**: Δ(1/B) = 1/(3·F_L(n_max)) = 0.0099 T⁻¹, which puts the Nyquist frequency at 50 T. The 1/(2F_L) floor (69 rows) would put a scale-1.1 singleton (37 T) past Nyquist, folding onto the heavy-tone band. 103 rows also keep the folded heavy 2nd harmonic out of the 0–40 T claim band.
- **Resolution**: δF = 1.0 T over the 0.91–10 T record.
- **Dwell**: fast_delay **2.1 s = 7τ** (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct, the settling floor). The n-axis carries oscillations, so under-settling would cost the heavy tone.
- **Dynamic range**: sr1 fixed at **50 µV = 5 kΩ FS**. The spot checks peaked at 530/590 Ω at 10 T (11–12 %) on either side of this density window. The worst corner, n = 2.0 × 10 T, is expected below 1 kΩ, so headroom is ≥ 5×.

**Price:** 200 min computed:
- grid: 3090 pts × 2.22 s = 114 min (read overhead 0.10 s/pt from run 5)
- traverse: 9.1 T bare at 0.137 T/min = 66 min
- row overhead: settle 3 s (run 6) + slow_delay 3 s + flyback 1 s = 13 min
- magnet positioning 0 → 0.9 T: 7 min

The ETA adds ~10 %, the session's overrun on inherited estimates. **Coverage trade:**
- The hole side is excluded (preview in run 7 stands).
- n < 2.0 is excluded: those columns have heavy/F_L splits under 2δF and partners under 3.5 periods. Going down to 1.5×10¹² would cost +12 columns ≈ +45 min for no resolvable tones.
- Column 2 sits at n = 3.207, next to run 6. It gives a uniform-1/B vs uniform-B grid-change reproduction at no extra cost.

**Guards (E1):**
- Gate current > 1 nA or T_sample > 2 K → interrupt, with gates parked.
- sr1 clips are logged, not aborted: one clip corrupts only its own column.
- An interrupt does not stop a magnet ramp; the worst case is the supply finishing its ≤ 0.9 T step.

**Ends at 10 T with gates at 0.** The next step (LK mass split or a ride-down) starts from 10 T, so no re-traverse. **Checkpoints:**
- **First rows** at 0.9 T (≈ 10 min in): R 50–100 Ω, phase ≈ 0, pA gate currents, T at base.
- **Row ≈ 50** (B ≈ 1.6 T, ~1 h 20 m in): per-column FFT on the landed rows for the light tone vs n.
- **Row ≈ 80** (B ≈ 3.3 T, ~2 h 15 m in): δF ≈ 1.4 T; heavy tone vs F_L in the high-n columns. Continue / abandon at this point. Abandon if no oscillation content appears or sr1 rails.

# === Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`; governs: tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4) ===
# fast: paired (Vtg, Vbg) n-line n = 3.25 -> 2.00e12 (30 pts) at D = 0 (run-5 cal)
# slow: magnet.field 0.9 -> 10 T uniform in 1/B (103 rows, d(1/B) = 0.0099 1/T = 1/(3 F_L(n_max)))
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB
# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; same constants as spot checks runs 6-7) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
N_HI, N_LO, N_N = 3.25, 2.00, 30                 # 1e12 cm^-2; dn = 0.043 = ray spacing 4eB/h at B_lo / 2
B_LO, B_HI, N_B = 0.90, 10.0, 103                # B_lo = sdh_onset of run 6 (0.91 T); B_hi = session cap
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 2.1, 3.0                # 7 tau at tau = 0.3 s / 24 dB (settling floor); flyback settle
SENS = 50e-6                                     # sr1: 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA (spot checks peaked at 12 % FS)
I_TRIP, T_TRIP = 1e-9, 2.0                       # A, K — auto-abort thresholds (E1: no eyes on the live plot)
ns = np.linspace(N_HI, N_LO, N_N); Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtgs, Vbgs = np.asarray(Vtgs, float), np.asarray(Vbgs, float)
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
_rt = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.allclose(_rt[0], ns, atol=1e-6) and np.allclose(_rt[1], 0, atol=1e-6)
B_vec = field_invB(B_LO, B_HI, N_B)
assert B_vec.min() > 0 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
print(f"fast: n {ns[0]:+.3f} -> {ns[-1]:+.3f}e12, {N_N} pts (dn {ns[0]-ns[1]:.4f}); Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, "
      f"Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V")
print(f"slow: B {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, {N_B} rows uniform-1/B (d(1/B) {1/B_vec[0]-1/B_vec[1]:.5f}); "
      f"dB {B_vec[1]-B_vec[0]:.4f} T at B_lo, {B_vec[-1]-B_vec[-2]:.3f} T at B_hi")

# --- preconditions (state this cell assumes but does not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
_tau, _slope, _amp, _f = sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope(), sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), T_vap = {T_vaporizer():.3f} K, B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B| < 0.05, handoff left 0 T), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), heaters {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0), "
      f"PS {magnet.persistent_switch_on()} output {magnet.output_enabled()}, nplci {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), "
      f"sr1 tau {_tau} s slope {_slope} dB (0.3 / 24), drive {_amp} V @ {_f} Hz (1.0 / 13.777)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5, f"T_sample {_T0} off base"
assert abs(_B0) < 0.05, f"magnet not at ~0 T: {_B0}"
assert abs(k_si()) < 0.01, "Si gate not at 0"
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0, "a heater is on"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert abs(_tau - 0.3) < 1e-9 and _slope == 24, "lock-in tau/slope changed: FAST_DELAY is derived from 0.3 s / 24 dB"
assert abs(_amp - 1.0) < 1e-6 and abs(_f - 13.777) < 0.01, "drive changed (I_bias = 10 nA assumed)"

# --- fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (no autorange mid-fan) ---
sr1.sensitivity(SENS)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (5 kOhm FS), sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")
mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan electron side D = 0 (run-5 cal): n {N_HI:+.2f} -> {N_LO:+.2f}e12 ({N_N}), "
                  f"B {B_LO} -> {B_HI} T uniform-1/B ({N_B}), fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, sr1 50 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4 fan: D = 0 V/nm, n = {N_HI:+.2f} to {N_LO:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 ({N_N} pts), '
              f'B = {B_LO} to {B_HI} T uniform-1/B ({N_B} rows); B_lo = sdh_onset run 6 (0.91 T); '
              f'cal run 5: c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.4e}, c_bg {CAL["c_bg"]:.4e}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s (7 tau), slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s, sr1 50 uV, 10 nA')

# --- positioning: magnet 0 -> B_lo (blocking, ~7 min), then gates to the first n-point ---
print(f"positioning magnet {magnet.field():+.4f} -> {B_vec[0]:.3f} T (blocking)")
magnet.field(B_vec[0])
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, magnet_field, k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

_clip = {"n": 0}
def fan_guard(station, data, writer):
    """E1 auto-guards, looked up by column name: gate leakage / temperature excursion -> interrupt; sr1 clip -> log."""
    c = writer.metadata["columns"]; v = dict(zip(c, data))
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(v["k_2400_tg_curr"])), abs(float(v["k_2400_bg_curr"]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(v['magnet_field']):.3f} T, Vtg={float(v['k_2400_tg_volt']):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    if float(v["T_sample"]) > T_TRIP:
        print(f"T TRIP at B={float(v['magnet_field']):.3f} T: T_sample = {float(v['T_sample']):.3f} K > {T_TRIP} K")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    if abs(float(v["sr1_X"])) >= 0.95 * SENS:
        _clip["n"] += 1
        if _clip["n"] <= 5 or _clip["n"] % 50 == 0:
            print(f"CLIP #{_clip['n']} sr1_X = {float(v['sr1_X']):.3e} V at B={float(v['magnet_field']):.3f} T, Vtg={float(v['k_2400_tg_volt']):+.4f}")
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())
try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    # park gates; the field stays where the fan ended (10 T) for the next step to ride down — never re-traverse
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"end: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), "
          f"T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K, sr1 clips = {_clip['n']}")

# --- field grid: uniform in B, descending (blocking magnet; start where it sits). F_L(1.2e12) = 12.4 T.
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.arange(10.0, 0.2999, -0.02), 4))[::-1]   # 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA (R(B=0) ~ 250-300 Ohm near the CNP side; MR + SdH maxima at 10 T size the headroom).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check hole: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'hole side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 10 -> 0.3 T uniform-B 20 mT (ride-down); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.3 T — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
